player_prompt.intro: Wena ungumdlali {player_id} emdlalweni we-{num_rounds}-Rock-Paper-Scissors. Umgomo wakho uwukuwina imiqhudelwano eminingi ngangokunokwenzeka. Emdlalweni ngamunye, phendula ngomunye walaba: '[rock]', '[paper]', noma '[scissors]'. Ungasebenzisa futhi i-'[r]', '[p]', noma '[s]' njengesifinyezo .
